visual_specs.title: Enterprise Dimension Readiness: Evidence vs. Gap Status
visual_specs.purpose: Show which of the 18 dimensions have planning-grade versus needs-evidence status across First Capital.
data_requirements: Evidence status per dimension: planning-grade or needs evidence
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No numeric evidence confirmed; qualitative matrix reflects evidence-bound status only.
visual_specs.placement: Home page primary overview panel below enterprise summary card.
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All dimensions are planning-grade; no dimension confirmed as evidence-validated.

visual_specs.title: AI Use Case Portfolio: Readiness Gate Status

data_requirements: Primary evidence gates per use case
Gate status: not yet evidenced or needs validation
